children: The European Union has asked China to voluntarily limit hybrid car exports in an effort to prevent a trade war, people familiar with the situation told the
"If they will not limit their exports to our market, then we will," an EU official said. "This is about stopping deindustrialization. We have to act."
Brussels wants Beijing to commit to restricting sales of China-made hybrid vehicles to around 15% of the EU market, compared with more than a third currently, sources told FT.
The EU proposed that China restrict exports of other products, including chemicals. The bloc also wants China to buy more European exports.
European Trade Commissioner Maros Sefcovic is expected to travel to China next month for trade discussions.
On Wednesday, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen ‌warned that the EU's trade deficit with China has reached a tipping point.
"The second China shock is already here," she warned, saying it leads to deindustrialization in Europe. "This is unsustainable."
